columns.name: id
columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Unchanged by this migration; row identity is preserved (PI1, AC3).

columns.name: sku
columns.description: SKU identity of the filed stock. Untouched by the refactor; part of UNIQUE (sku, location) (PI4).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Canonical physical location. Stays canonical and is NOT recreated from inventory_code; part of UNIQUE (sku, location) (PI4). Reused by the downgrade to reconstruct inventory_code (PI3, AC6).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Filed stock level. Untouched; CHECK >= 0 preserved from F1.

columns.name: batch_number
columns.description: Second hyphen-delimited segment split out of the legacy inventory_code (AC1). NULLABLE so a non-conforming/short code backfills to NULL rather than a guessed value (PI2, AC2).

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Third hyphen-delimited segment split out of the legacy inventory_code (AC1). NULLABLE so a non-conforming/short code backfills to NULL rather than a guessed value (PI2, AC2).

schema_changes.detail: Add batch_number text NULL and serial_number text NULL (PI2, AC1/AC2). Additive-first step so pre-existing rows are preserved before any destructive change (NFR-F6-7).
schema_changes.migration_note: Wrap the whole up migration (add + backfill + probe + drop) in a single transaction so it is atomic: all rows survive with unchanged identity and location or the migration rolls back (PI1, AC3). downgrade() drops these two columns after reconstructing inventory_code.

schema_changes.detail: Backfill batch_number = split_part(inventory_code,'-',2), serial_number = split_part(inventory_code,'-',3) only for well-formed 3-segment codes; leave both NULL for short/malformed codes (AC1, AC2). Then emit a COUNT probe of rows left NULL for operator review before the drop is accepted (AC4, NFR-F6-6).
schema_changes.migration_note: Backfill is data-only (no schema shape change). Use split_part / NULLIF so malformed codes tolerate without raising. The probe gates the destructive drop (AC4 -> AC5, NFR-F6-7).

schema_changes.detail: Drop the combined inventory_code column after backfill and probe complete (AC5).
schema_changes.migration_note: Reversible via expand/contract: downgrade() re-adds inventory_code text NULL and reconstructs it as location || '-' || batch_number || '-' || serial_number for split rows (NULL where batch/serial are NULL), then drops batch_number/serial_number, restoring the pre-migration schema shape for a clean up-then-down round trip (PI3, AC6). UNIQUE (sku, location) is never touched across up or down (PI4).
